method: Official npm tarball verified SHA512/SHA1 and repository/version/MIT; exact MIT license retained. Runtime is that browser ESM plus the isolated documented stored-block strictness patch. No installation or runtime CDN.
preparationNote: First in-memory package check assumed repository was an object; package.json uses a string. That check stopped before writes and caused one redundant same-package retrieval. No vendor execution or installation.

localPatch.scope: Only validate stored-block LEN/NLEN complement, after complete stored block is available. Original npm source archived outside source/.
localPatch.reason: Actual normal native rejects, unmodified fflate accepts the same malformed gzip with matching output CRC/ISIZE/SHA.
